justin-allen-clayton.text: Campaign frames his candidacy around "accountability, passion and shared responsibility to keep Los Angeles courts fair and accessible for every resident."

anna-slotky-reitano.text: Judicial philosophy centered on applying the law "not ideology": constitutional fairness, due process, and dignity and respect for all persons in court.
